The estate concept

Designed around security, comfort and connection.

TRIXX Gated Community is a proposed development brief that brings together premium homes, landscaped public spaces, smart-infrastructure planning and community-focused amenities. The project remains a concept until the selected site, planning review, costs and engineering studies are confirmed.

Visuals, home types and estate programmes are illustrative only and should be treated as early-stage concept material, not final development approvals or sale specifications.

Residential clusters

Three neighbourhoods

Dispersion into smaller clusters improves privacy, phased delivery and community identity while keeping the estate feeling cohesive.

Amenities

Shared life, not just shared walls

Landscape trails, a central green, clubhouse amenities and recreation spaces help build a balanced residential environment.

Technology

Intelligent by default

Secure entry systems, energy monitoring, water-management planning and connected community services create a more future-ready estate.

Status

Concept only

Home counts, pricing, planning approvals, engineering details and exact timelines remain subject to land, location and professional review.
